For parents

Momo the monster orders food in French. Your child reads the order, taps the right food onto the tray, counts, and presses Miam ! to feed him. The game needs reading to win: the order only exists as text.

Stars for reading

  • 3 stars: the order was read with no help.
  • 2 stars: your child tapped a word to hear it (or see its picture).
  • 1 star: they played the whole sentence aloud, or showed the English with EN.
  • Mistakes cost nothing. Momo writes a hint in red pen, and your child fixes the tray.

Mon monstre

Your child can design Momo: an animal (moose is l'élan in France, l'orignal in Canada), a body shape, one to six eyes, and a colour. Every 5 levels wins a hat, glasses or a pattern. Each choice is said aloud in French.

100 levels in 10 worlds
